The voiceover captures are synthetic fixture evidence; this verdict does not certify every interface or reproduce the original freeze. These 480 × 320 captures display the fixed 240 × 160 framebuffer at integer 2× scale. Dark mode is the product default with persistent Key System opt-out. rules.name: The Semantic Palette Rule
rules.body: Change UI surfaces through known indexed entries; preserve sprite, type, HP and status palettes.

dos: Do use shared night tokens for UI surfaces and text.
Do measure strings with the engine font helpers and check actual native frames.
Do distinguish no encounters, unseen species and known species.
Do retain search, registration, filters, collection, visibility rules and save behavior.
donts: Don't recolor Pokémon sprites, type icons, HP bars or status meanings with surface tokens.
Don't introduce browser layout, scalable fonts, hover-only actions or touch controls.
Don't claim every screen has been redesigned or visually verified.
Don't create new generated raster assets for this theme.
